LanguageData.DMSL_Building_BandwidthAmplifier.label: Bandwidth amplifier
LanguageData.DMSL_Building_BandwidthAmplifier.descrip: A device that assists mechanitors in controlling mechanoids. It has a built-in energy storage unit and can continue to provide stable bandwidth when power is cut.\n\nProvides 2 bandwidth by default. After researching "Cluster Transceiver", it is enhanced to provide 3 bandwidth and improves charge rate and capacity while reducing power demand.
LanguageData.DMSL_Building_IntegratedDetectionArray.d: A combined tactical facility for electronic warfare and resource reconnaissance. It can automatically perform local vein scanning or long-range mineral scanning, and can also produce decoy coordinates to disrupt enemy airstrike target selection.
